wars.outcome: The Kaqchikel defeated the K'iche' around 1491 and crushed an internal Akajal and Tukuche revolt on 20 May 1493; 'in 1522 a peace accord was made'. No border change is dated.
wars.note: The Iximche page is the source of 1491 and 1493; the K'iche' page gives 1475 and 1522.

wars.name: Kaqchikel revolt against the Spanish

zones.text: the Kaqchikel country around Iximche in Chimaltenango Department; the pages give no frontier

wars.outcome: After the alliance of April 1524 the Kaqchikel fled Iximche on 28 August 1524 and fought on; the Spanish abandoned Tecpan in 1527, burned the palace of the Ahpo Xahil (a group of sixteen Spanish deserters, 9 February 1526) and the Kaqchikel kings surrendered on 9 May 1530.
wars.note: Part of the Spanish conquest of Guatemala.

notes:
NEW STATE. Cliopatria has no Kaqchikel row.
THIN ON TERRITORY. None of the three pages gives a Kaqchikel frontier, a figure for area or a list of towns; Chimaltenango Department is where Iximche lies and is a placeholder shape (soft). The Acajal (Chajoma) of Mixco Viejo, who 'kept political autonomy', are not inside it.
DISAGREEMENTS. Tecpan Guatemala was founded 25 July 1524 (Kaqchikel people page) or the Spanish capital declared at Iximche on 27 July 1524 (Iximche and conquest pages); not entered as an event. The 1470-1485 founding range is the Iximche page's; the Kaqchikel people page puts Chi Awar at about 1430 and independence at about 1470.
ALLIANCE. The Kaqchikel fought with Alvarado against the K'iche' and the Tz'utujil in 1524 (Iximche page, no dates for the Tz'utujil campaign; the conquest page dates the Atitlan battle 18 April 1524). The vassal_start/vassal_end pair is the researcher's reading of 'tribute' and the pact.
COUNTERPARTS. K'iche' is a dossier of this batch; Tz'utujil and Acajal have none.
